t: A Pyrenean kingdom that took Zaragoza and the Ebro valley from al-Andalus in the twelfth century.
Petronila's marriage to the count of Barcelona created the Crown of Aragon, which later joined Castile to form Spain.
Its Cortes, fueros and the Justicia limited royal power until Philip V abolished them in 1707.
dyk: Ramiro II, a monk called from the cloister to the throne in 1134, married to provide an heir and retired to monastic life once his baby daughter Petronila was betrothed.
ev: Ramiro I receives Aragon on the death of Sancho III of Navarre
Peter I takes Huesca after the Battle of Alcoraz
Alfonso I the Battler captures Zaragoza
Petronila is betrothed to Ramon Berenguer IV, count of Barcelona
Peter III grants the General Privilege to the Union of Aragon
Ferdinand II of Aragon marries Isabella of Castile
The Justicia Juan de Lanuza is executed after the Antonio Pérez affair
The Nueva Planta decrees abolish Aragon's fueros
